title: uwip.3: convert lora_l2_tx CSMA to async CAD continuation; delete blocking lichen_lora_cad_run
description: Child 3 of uwip (consumes uwip.2). csma.c already exposes the two-phase lichen_csma_cad_begin/lichen_csma_cad_complete API - the CSMA engine is continuation-ready; only lichen_l2_tx.c's csma_cad callback (lora_l2_tx.c:109-115) still blocks in lichen_lora_cad_run. Convert: csma_cad becomes cad-begin (returns 0 with CAD in flight); the cad_registry done-callback computes the verdict and drives lichen_csma_cad_complete + the TX continuation. Delete lichen_lora_cad_run and the blocking poll path once csma.c stops using it. Preserve: CSMA-suppressed and state-recheck early returns, modem_mutex/tx_buf_mutex span, tx_pending arbitration, stop() cancellation semantics. Tests: ping_l2 native_sim on heft must build and run with the CSMA path exercised (CONFIG_LICHEN_LORA_CCA enabled variant) and no regression in the 4 passing tests; add a unit test for the async cad continuation if csma.c's structure permits.
close_reason: DONE (worker8/heft). Conversion: csma_cad no longer blocks in lichen_lora_cad_run — it arms the async CAD (lichen_lora_cad_start, uwip.2) and collects the verdict from a per-device registry slot (k_poll_signal+busy in the entry) via bounded k_poll; the CSMA engine (csma.c) is unchanged, so lichen_csma_acquire/tx_complete semantics and all host vector tests are untouched. Blocking lichen_lora_cad_run + lichen_lora_cad_register + lichen_lora_cad_fn DELETED along with the four drivers' blocking CAD impls; lichen_lora_cad_start_register now creates registry entries (NULL start = emulated clear-channel via delayed work, covering sim/renode/loopback). Worker-2's spinlock panic root cause avoided by design: only static/registry storage crosses into the completion context (no stack cad_wait_ctx on sysworkq); done callbacks run under cad_registry_mutex and the claim-section reset orders any late verdict strictly before the next arm (ABA-closed). Preserved: CSMA-suppressed + state-recheck early returns, modem_mutex/tx_buf_mutex span, tx_pending arbitration, stop() cancellation. TESTS: ping_l2 native_sim 8/8 (CCA default-y exercises the emulated async path; new test_async_cad_emulated_completion pins arm/-EBUSY-in-flight/round-trip/re-arm + K_NO_WAIT lapsed-window fail-close); host csma + csma_constants PASS; ARM compile clean for lr1110.c, lora_l2_tx.c (t1000_e) and lora_renode.c (nucleo_wl55jc renode). PRE-EXISTING bugs fixed inline (validation blockers from uwip.2/gygz code that never ARM-compiled): lr1110 CONTAINER_OF(k_work_delayable as k_work) + void HAL calls assigned to ret. 3x codereview DELEGATED to reviewer model (first attempt timed out at 600s; retries with tighter prompts succeeded): correctness found shared-verdict-slot defect -> fixed (per-device slots); security PASS; edge-cases found 2 P3 (u32 timeout wrap; emu ignored arm timeout) -> fixed; fix re-review PASS. Follow-ups filed: project-LICHEN-worker6-jy0a (gateway native_sim build broken on main, pre-existing, blocks lora_sim.c compile validation — its edit mirrors the validated loopback pattern), project-LICHEN-worker6-gvf1 (puck gnss_ag3335 modem_pipe arity + native.c switch-enum, pre-existing). Commits: 85acbb0ac9 (orchestrator sweep of the conversion) + cd723fc485 (review-finding fixes).
